newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Dover Downs, Arden.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Dover Downs, Arden.

text.p: Racetrack operator Dover Downs Entertainment Inc shares surged after the company's $42.5 million initial public offering on Friday.

Its shares jumped four to 21, up almost 25 percent, leading the winning stocks on the New York Stock Exchange. The company offered 2.5 million shares for $17 each. Dover Downs operates the Dover Downs International Speedway, the Dover Downs Raceway and a video lottery casino in Dover, Del.
Merrill Lynch & Co was the lead underwriter of the IPO.
Two other deals had sizzling showings at their market debuts this morning, Arden Realty Group Inc and Metzler Group Inc, while Integrated Living Communities Inc opened flat.
-- Arden Realty shares rose 2-1/2 from their IPO price of $20 a share. The company offered about 18.8 million shares for $20 each, according to lead underwriter Lehman Brothers.
The real estate company is based in Beverly Hills, Calif.

-- Metzler Group shares surged over 100 percent, up 10-3/8 to 20-3/8. The company offered 3.52 million shares for $16 each in the $56 million IPO, which was underwritten by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette. The shares priced at the top of their estimated range of $14 to $16.
Metler provides consulting services to electric utilities and other energy-related businesses. It poasted revenue growth of 29 percent from 1994 to 1995, according to its prospectus.
-- Integrated Living shares, which priced at $8 for their IPO, slipped 1/4 to 7-3/4 in late afternoon trading.
The shares priced at the low end of their estimated pricing range of $8 to $10. Previously, they had been estimated to price in a range of $13 to $15.
The company provides assisted living and other services to the private-pay elderly market.
